json.body: Sandoval puts Ironvale ahead in minute 8 during an open start. After a chaotic spell, Okafor levels the contest for Verdant in minute 23. Both sides go into the break on level terms after trading early strikes.

cards.text: The contest shifts frequently between transitional and settled phases, punctuated by two extended chaotic spells prior to the equaliser.
cards.title: How the half felt

cards.text: Okafor steps up for Verdant with the crucial equalising goal in minute 23 to restore parity.
cards.title: Player of the half

json.headline: Okafor cancels out Sandoval's early opener
